channel.title: Smart Cities Dive - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Smart Cities Dive (smartcitiesdive.com)

item.title: Brooklyn project shows feasibility of using geothermal in dense urban areas
item.description: Although installation costs are higher than for conventional systems, geothermal is cheaper over the long term, project consultants say.

item.title: APTA calls for $268B investment in public transit and passenger rail over 5 years
item.description: The American Public Transportation Association urges Congress to support transit investment in the upcoming surface transportation legislation.

item.title: 4 ways Oklahoma can ease its affordable housing crisis
item.description: An Urban Institute study detailed challenges in Oklahoma’s housing market but also noted solutions for the state.

item.title: NYC public housing has a vacancy problem, an investigation found. Squatters are filling the gaps.
item.description: The number of vacant New York City Housing Authority apartments increased nearly 140% from 2022 to 2025, a New York City Department of Investigation report found. The vacancies are posing safety risks.

item.title: DHS funding impasse freezes security grants, stalls local law enforcement
item.description: The shutdown “has essentially paralyzed local operations by delaying funding and grant rollouts and by furloughing critical personnel,” a sheriffs coalition said in a letter to Congress.

item.title: EPA delays greenhouse gas reporting as it moves to shut down program
item.description: Covered entities for the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program will not be required to submit 2025 emissions data until October. By then, the agency may have already repealed the requirement.

item.title: Atlanta transit agency to launch on-demand service Saturday
item.description: Shared rides on transit vans within 12 metro Atlanta areas will provide point-to-point service at the same $2.50 bus and rail fare.

item.title: Better weather forecasts, disaster reviews the goal of new federal bills
item.description: As emergency managers warn NOAA and National Weather Service cuts threaten public safety, the proposals would further investigate major weather disasters and invest in forecasting technology.

item.title: 360-degree cameras eliminate blind spots for intercity bus drivers
item.description: Coach USA employed AI cameras to give their drivers a better view of their surroundings, cutting preventable accidents by 92%.

item.title: 2 major cities update homelessness plans to focus on permanent housing
item.description: Both Phoenix and Oakland, California, saw increases in unsheltered homelessness in recent years.
